rom.text: Escalate a problem the machine handled when it repeats 3 times in 24 h, is not recovered after 30 minutes, spreads to another node, or puts life at risk. Do not interfere when the machine handled it. Fire: call the fire brigade at once and tell the owner. Flood or storm: tell the owner first; call civil protection only if water enters the barn or there is a tornado strike or extreme wind and the owner has not answered within 5 minutes.
Approved protective actions (DANGER only, own machine only): deploy_shutters, deploy_flood_barrier, close_gates, activate_alarm
